snippet.title: Saturday AM Battle Manga Trailer
snippet.description:
SATURDAY AM BATTLE MANGA is the first official video game based on the popular manga brand featuring characters from hit series like CLOCK STRIKER, APPLE BLACK, HAMMER, and SOUL BEAT.

WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3963220/Saturday_AM_Battle_Manga/

The 2V2 fighter is a fast-paced brawler with character designs inspired by both the manga and the aesthetic of each series’ actual creator, featuring unique features and presentation meant to mimic the visual intensity and style of Japanese battle manga tropes. 

Planned with rollback netcode for online play, the game has just begun full development, with this trailer offering an early look at the initial models and animations developed in the UNREAL engine.

———————————————————————————————————————————

Saturday AM is the longest-running diverse manga brand and largest black-owned manga publisher with award-winning original manga from creators from Nigeria to France, USA to New Zealand, and more! The manga is sold in bookstores and comic shops in dozens of countries around the world, as well as through official merchandise across apparel, digital products, and more. Saturday AM titles are also found in libraries and popular e-commerce platforms, from Kindle to Kobo, Apple to Google.

With 14 planned characters, new and established voice actors, and an elaborate story mode based on Saturday AM’s large library of manga-inspired comics, Saturday AM BATTLE MANGA has more details to announce soon.

🎮 Game Info

Developer: Son Studios

Release Date: TBA

Platforms: Consoles to be announced / STEAM®

Genre: 2v2 Fighting Game

Original Work: #CLOCKSTRIKER by Frederick L. Jones x Issaka Galadima / #APPLEBLACK by Odunze Oguguo aka Whyt Manga / SOUL BEAT by Morganne Walker / HAMMER by Jeyodin via #saturdayam

All characters, brand, and logos © their respective creators. All Rights Reserved.
